title: Animal mushaira is the new face of AI slop on desi Instagram. Everyone loves Rita Bhonkni
key_facts: AI-generated videos of animals reciting Urdu poetry at a mushaira (poetry gathering) have gone viral on Indian Instagram
A cat host named Shagufta Ghurghuri introduces a dog poet, Rita Bhonkni, and her rival Nagina Dasni, a snake in a green lehenga
Other characters include a camel, a porcupine and a frog, each reciting verse suited to its species
The lore includes a fake death announcement for Rita Bhonkni, her return, and accusations that Nagina spread the rumour
Fans run polls, debates and commentary videos; creator Nehal Pasha said not knowing the lore means 'we can't be friends'
The writer, in an opinion column, still calls it AI slop despite the fashion and Urdu poetry
quote_evidence: The moment desi internet decided it was over AI-generated vegetable dramas, AI mushaira animals showed up to take the slop-cake.
The rivalry got more heated when news broke that Rita Bhonkni had died — "Rita Bhonkni ka inteqaal ho gaya" — followed immediately by fans grieving.
Banger fashion aside, it is still AI slop, no matter how much tehzeeb and Urdu shayari you wrap it in.
why_it_matters_hint: A fully AI-made soap opera of animal poets shows how fast synthetic entertainment finds a mass audience
notes: Opinion column in ThePrint's Viral Spiral series; no view counts or creator names for the videos given.
